integrity_statement: All stated conclusions follow from an explicit finite-sample KL reduction and elementary convexity. Numerical checks corroborate but do not prove asymptotics. Literature comparisons do not establish absolute historical priority.
scientific_limitations: Applies only to maxima of iid exponential variables, forward Kullback--Leibler divergence, and the full two-parameter Gumbel location-scale family. It does not determine general extreme-value domains, optimal reverse KL, data-estimation performance, or independent historical priority.
title: Optimal finite-sample Gumbel calibration of exponential maxima
